brief:
Palestinian residents of Jericho face displacement as settlers take control of their homes in the occupied West Bank, Al Jazeera English reported. The seizures come amid assaults on Palestinians and demolitions of residential structures in the area, heightening fears of a broader takeover.

The incidents reflect intensifying pressure on Palestinian communities in the territory, with residents concerned about their ability to remain in their ancestral lands as settler expansion continues.
dek: Palestinians are assaulted and their homes are levelled in pogrom in occupied West Bank.
title: Israeli settlers seize Palestinian homes in Jericho amid assault campaign
